page.layout: One printed page, one text block in a single column; a running head ornament at the top; no page number; faint show-through from the other side and a few marginal fragments at the left edge, which are not transcribed.

main_text.head: Coloss. 2.
main_text.p: 5. Et si corpore absum, spiritu tamen sum vobiscum, gaudens ac cernens vestrum ordinem, & soliditatem vestræ in Christum fidei.
main_text.head: 1. Timoth. 3.
main_text.p: 14. Hæc tibi scribo, sperans fore ut celerius ad te veniam.
15 Quod si tardius venero, ut noris quomodo oporteat in domo Dei versari, quæ est Ecclesia Dei vivi, columna & stabilimentum veritatis.
main_text.head: Hebr. 12.
main_text.p: 25. Non deserentes aggregationem nostri mutuam, sicuti mos est quibusdam: sed adhortantes alij alios: idque eò magis quò videtis illum diem appropinquare.

page.notes: The running head is an ornamental border; the heading "Coloss. 2." at the top is printed as a running title above the text. The head "Hebr. 12." is set in the printed form "Hcb. 12."; the transcription follows the scan's spelling as far as legible. Show-through and marginal stains at the left edge were not transcribed.
